title: Find Payment Behaviour Summary By Debtor Party
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:48 AM

Find Payment Behaviour Summary By Debtor Party

Definition

To find payment behavior information of a debtor.

Technical Data

Entity Type                                         Service Operation

Release State                                      released

Technical Name                                 CreditManagementAccountERPPaymentBehaviourSummaryByDebtorPartyQueryResponse_In
Namespace                                        http://sap.com/xi/FICA/Global2 rt.
Application Component                         FI-CA

Web Service Definition (Back End)           FKK_CMAPaymBehSummBDPQR
Category                                            SAP A2A

Direction                                                inbound

Mode                                                    synchronous

Idempotency                                          no

Change/Update Behavior                         not applicable

P2P Communication Enabled                  true

Business Context and Use

This service operation queries information about the payment behavior of business partners from the system in which Contract
Accounts Receivable and Payable (FI-CA) is running and sends the response to the Credit Management system.

Features

The response of the Find Payment Behaviour Summary By Debtor Party service operation transfers information about business
partners’ payment behavior to the Credit Management process component.

The following data is transferred:

e DebtorPartylInternallD
e CreditSegmentinternallD

e CumulatedReceivablesAmount
